### Question#1
```{r}
# a. Create a vector for the workers' ages
worker_age <- c(34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35,
                31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37,
                46, 25, 17, 37, 43, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33,
                41, 53, 40, 18, 44, 38, 41, 48, 27, 39, 19,
                30, 61, 54, 58, 26, 18)

# b. How many data points?
length(worker_age)

# c. Minimum and maximum age
min(worker_age)
max(worker_age)

# d. Access the 13th to 18th and 33rd to 35th elements
worker_age[13:18]
worker_age[33:35]

# e. Exclude the 10th, 20th, 30th, and 40th elements
worker_age[-c(10, 20, 30, 40)]

# f. Change the 4th, 14th, 24th, and 44th elements to 0
worker_age[c(4, 14, 24, 44)] <- 0

worker_age
```

### Question#4
```{r}
vegetables <- list(
  "Carrot", "Cabbage", "Broccoli", "Spinach", "Potato",
  "Eggplant", "Squash", "Cauliflower", "Okra", "Cucumber"
)
```
A.
vegetables <- append(vegetables, c("Onion", "Tomato"))

B.
length(vegetables)

C.
vegetables <- append(
  vegetables,
  c("Lettuce", "Radish", "Celery", "Garlic"),
  after = 5
)

D.
length(vegetables)
